definitions: The dead body of an animal, especially one that has been killed for food or is found dead.
The remains of a structure, such as a building or vehicle, after it has been damaged or destroyed.
The main framework or body of something, without its coverings or contents.
examples: The lion feasted on the zebra carcass.
Only the burnt-out carcass of the car remained.
The ship's carcass was visible at low tide.
